args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and
tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding. Align the implementation
with the documented behavior so the nightly build passes.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.round_money` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
Updated the rounding mode import and usage in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including:
- `test_half_even` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66)
